1.

Holy Father! Gratefully we sing Thy praise, Thou who hast prepared For us a path in the wilderness.

2.

Thanks that Thou dost lead Ever with Thy faithful hand, And dost deliver us From every hindering bond!

3.

Thou who didst speak Once in fire and in judgment, Now dost speak to us Through Thy beloved Son.

4.

Sweetly Thou dost speak, Speakest in grace, O our God; Weakest hearts Are strengthened by the sound of love.

5.

Of old on the stone Thou didst write Thy holy law, But now Thou hast written: Grace is my heart’s delight.

6.

And in the minds That here hearken to Thy voice, Thy will’s ways Thou yet dost desire to inscribe.

7.

May then our heart Be a tablet so pure, That with Thy Spirit Thou mayest write more and more upon it.
